whenToUse: Search and filter fields that suggest matching options while the user types
People and record lookups, grouped by team or fetched from a server as the query changes
Form fields whose typed or picked text is validated with the rest of the form on submit

whenNotToUse.when: A selection that stores the chosen option rather than typed text, or several as chips
Options nested in levels that the user drills into one level at a time
A palette of app actions and keyboard shortcuts, often opened in a dialog

agentNotes: `value` and `onValueChange` carry the input text as a string; picking an item only fills that text and stores no item object
Both twins are built on `@base-ui/react`, so installing it in a radix project adds Base UI as a dependency
A Server Component cannot create the function child of `AutocompleteList`, so the file that renders it needs a use client directive
